Name: Customizable Heart Relationship Icon
Author: AirynS
Description:
This mod changes the circular heart level indicator next to a character's portrait so that it looks like a heart instead! There are 22 preset colour combinations available, each consisting of 5 colours for 0-1 hearts, 2-3 hearts, 4-5 hearts, 6-7 hearts, and 8-9 hearts, or you can customise each of these individually with 30 different colour options. You can also choose whether to keep the default iridium star for the 10 heart marker or whether to customise this as a heart or a coloured star.

It also includes an option for special compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13996]Welcome to Mineral Town [/url]- if enabled, the relationship icon will automatically switch to a preset colour palette inspired by the heart colours in Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town while in any location added by WtMT.


[size=4][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]:

[/size][list]
[*][b]PresetColourScheme: [/b]Select if you'd like to use a premade colour scheme. Choose 'custom' if you'd like to individually configure the colours for each heart level.
[/list][i] Options[/i]: Custom, Stardew, HarvestMoon, Bookstore, Fire, Floral, Halloween, Magic, Metallic, Monochrome, Nature, Ocean, Pastel, Rainforest, Sky, Ace, Aro, Bi, Gay, Lesbian, Nonbinary, Pan, Trans

[list]
[*][b]UseHMPresetInMineralTown: [/b]Toggle whether you'd like to automatically switch to the Harvest Moon preset while in maps added by Welcome to Mineral Town.
[/list] [i]﻿Options[/i]: True, False

[list]
[*][b]Keep10HeartStar: [/b]Toggle whether you'd like to keep the default iridium star icon at 10 hearts or replace it with either a coloured heart or a coloured star.[i] ﻿[/i]
[/list][i] ﻿Options[/i]: Default, ColouredStar, ColouredHeart

[list]
[*][b]Custom0HeartColour[/b]
[*][b]Custom2HeartColour[/b]
[*][b]Custom4HeartColour[/b]
[*][b]Custom6HeartColour[/b]
[*][b]Custom8HeartColour[/b]
[*][b]Custom10HeartStarColour: [/b]Choose which colour to use for the matching hearts icon.[b][/b]
[/list]
[i] ﻿Options[/i]: All configs have the following colours available: Azure, Black, Blue, Bronze, Brown, Charcoal, CherryBlossom, Coral, Cream, Green, Grey, Indigo, Lavender, Lemon, Lilac, Lime, Magenta, Mint, Olive, Orange, Pink, Purple, Raspberry, Red, Rose, Silver, Teal, Turquoise, White, Yellow


[size=4][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]:

[size=3]This mod should be compatible with all other recolour mods and UI mods as it uses overlays and late priority. The only mods it is not compatible with are those that replace the relationship icon directly, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2846]Ran's Hearts[/url] ﻿(the inspiration for this mod), ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3002]More Stardew-y Relationship Indicators[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10676]Cat Paw Relationship Indicators[/url]﻿. If you find a recolour mod that is overwriting this one, you can edit it for personal use by adding a false dependency to this mod's manifest - see [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Tutorial:_How_to_Add_a_False_Dependency_for_Load_Orders]this tutorial [/url]if you're not sure how to do that.

[b]Not compatible with the Galdoran UI theme from SVE and I will not provide compatibility.[/b]

The seasonal outfits visible in the screenshots are from [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]. [/size][/size]
